description: This file defines the AuthCodeRepository class, implementing methods for persisting, revoking, and checking the status of OAuth2 authorization codes within the application, following the League OAuth2 server interface.

classes.name: AuthCodeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 auth code storage and management functions according to OAuth2 server standards.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a BeanManager instance.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Persists a new OAuth2 authorization code to storage.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a specific auth code has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity.
